lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Mg12Ni2 (SrMg6Ni) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell across 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Mg, Ni, and Sr centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments involve varying Mg, Ni, and Sr neighbor compositions. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra connected through corner, edge, and face contacts, and Mg–Ni polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
